Cargo ship collides with fishing boat near Singapore

A Panama-flagged bulk carrier collided with a Chinese fishing boat in waters near the Singapore Strait. Verified footage appears to show the moment of the crash. Investigators are working to establish the exact time and circumstances of the incident. No casualties have been reported.
